tagline.en: An interactive world model with long-term memory, keeping scenes consistent over time — demonstrated in Minecraft-style environments.
tagline.zh: 一个带长期记忆的可交互世界模型,让场景随时间保持一致——在 Minecraft 式环境中做了演示。

en: WorldMem is an interactive world model whose central idea is memory: as you explore and act in a generated environment, it remembers what it has already produced, so places you revisit stay consistent instead of drifting or being regenerated differently.

It is demonstrated in Minecraft-style environments, where an agent moves through a world that the model keeps coherent over long horizons. The work is described in an accompanying paper and project page and distributed as upstream source.
In WorldFoundry the route is registered so you can resolve its config and inference path; the model and data assets are staged separately, and the runtime lists what it needs before generating.
zh: WorldMem 是一个可交互世界模型,其核心思想是记忆:当你在生成的环境中探索和行动时,它会记住已经生成过的内容,因此你再次回到某处时,场景保持一致,而不会漂移或被重新生成成另一个样子。
它在 Minecraft 式环境中做了演示,智能体在模型长时保持连贯的世界里移动。相关工作有配套论文与项目主页,并以上游源码形式发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,其路径已被注册,你可以解析它的配置与推理路径;模型与数据素材需另行准备,运行时会在生成前列出所需内容。

whenToUse.en: Use WorldMem when long-term consistency matters — an interactive, explorable world where revisited locations should remain stable over time.
whenToUse.zh: 当长期一致性很重要时,适合使用 WorldMem——一个可交互、可探索的世界,其中重访的地点应随时间保持稳定。

notFor.en: It is a research codebase demonstrated in game-style environments; you must stage its model and data assets before real generation.
notFor.zh: 它是在游戏式环境中演示的研究代码库;真实生成前需准备好其模型与数据素材。
